notes: All 41 chunk ids checked. Cross-chunk finds NOT added here (their parents are in other chunks): (1) Valarr [valarr, chunk 1] + Kiera of Tyrosh: 'Stillborn sons' (AWOIAF Kiera of Tyrosh Issue: 'Stillborn sons'; 'During her marriage to Prince Valarr Targaryen, Kiera gave birth to sons, though unfortunately they were stillborn.'). (2) Aegon IV [chunk 1] + Naerys [chunk 3]: AWOIAF Naerys Issue lists 'Stillborn son (twin to Daenerys)' born 172 AC and 'Unnamed child (died with Naerys during labor)' 179 AC (page: child 'never mentioned again and most likely died too' - hedged). Skipped as not canon / not children: Aerion's possible bastards in Lys (AWOIAF: 'According to a semi-canon source, he may have fathered some bastard children' - So Spake Martin); Aegor Rivers 'had no children' (semi-canon); Maelys's son (unpublished drafts only); Maelys's 'nameless twin brother' he 'supposedly devoured in the womb' (a sibling of Maelys, parents unknown, cannot be attached); Rhaella's miscarriages in 263, 264 and 271 AC (not in AWOIAF Issue). order_after: the three new Aerys II children after 269 all point to daeron_a2 (the nearest existing sibling); their AWOIAF order is stillborn child (270) -> Aegon (272) -> Jaehaerys (274), as listed here, all before Viserys. Daella/Rhae children: father unknown, legitimacy not stated ('T' assumed). Children of Daenerys (daughter of Aegon IV) are Martells: parent set to maron per the brief; may duplicate a Martell-band audit. Other data discrepancies seen (not children): daeron_a2 died 269 or 270 AC ('lived for only half a year'), tree d= empty; rhaego AWOIAF born/died early 299 AC (tree 298); matarys born 183 AC (tree b= empty); daemon3_bf born in or after 202 AC; twins_n is the 161 AC twins group (AWOIAF Naerys: 'Unnamed twins (died shortly after birth)') - already on the tree, OK.
